Nonultimate periodicity plus its implications for any nonzero translation establish all distinct q and s,t triples are inequivalent. At e>=B+3 the q=0 or1 classes stabilize: the RS values differ at 4j+2 and 4j+3, so every five-consecutive-integers window realizes both. Counting dyadic levels yields 4m+2; c=0 and short shifts checked. Independently wrote BFS of arithmetic residual transitions and direct short-interval formulas for c=0..1023, matching complete state sets, and verified 13 dyadic shifts; inspected source checker.py and checker_output.txt (2048 claimed earlier checks). Finite tests support the symbolic all-offset proof, not extrapolated.
